text:
maria: quick q — updating the SDK docs for model selection behavior. If a client sends model_ids=["gptx-1", "redwood-1"] plus routing_hint={region: "eu", tier: "standard"} and the router falls back to a different variant (e.g. redwood-1-v2), what do we guarantee in the response shape? i need a small JSON example i can paste into the docs.

alex: current contract: responses include a served_model object with at least these additive fields: id (string), variant (string or null), origin (one of requested|pinned|fallback), and reason_chain (array of short reason codes). older clients only require served_model.id to be a string. everything else must be additive.

jordan: also, if multiple fallback steps happen we include served_models (array) where served_models[0] is the final chosen model and the rest show the chain we attempted. SDKs should read served_models[0] or served_model (we keep both for a transition window).

maria: ok can someone paste the minimal example here so i can copy it into the SDK docs?

sam: here's a compact example you can use:

```json
{
  "served_model": {
    "id": "redwood-1-v2",
    "variant": "q4_0",
    "origin": "fallback",
    "reason_chain": ["model_incompatibility","region_capacity"],
    "region": "eu-west-1"
  },
  "output": "<generated text>"
}
```

lee: small compatibility note: older SDKs assume served_model.id is a string (not an object). please do NOT change the id type. if you add fields, make them optional. also avoid renaming served_model -> servedModel in the public contract.

alex: agreed. one more field we started adding in router canaries is served_model.revision (string) when model pinning is in effect — additive only. if you're listing example fields, include revision as optional.

maria: this is perfect. @jordan can you update the SDK PR with this snippet and add a unit test asserting presence of served_model.id and origin for fallback cases? i'll review after you mark ready.

jordan: on it — draft PR #428, will add tests and a brief note about served_models array vs served_model for transition. cc @sam for router test changes.

deploy-bot: canary: router fallback-chain logging enabled in us-east-1 (deploy id dpl-2026-03-17-73)

maria: noted — i'll hold off on merging doc changes until canary looks stable. :thumbsup:
